mapper.select: SELECT id,created_by_admin_user_id AS owner,request_digest AS digest,mode,COALESCE(target_count,0) AS targets, issued_quantity AS quantity,completed_at FROM coupon_distribution WHERE request_id=#{key}
SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.user_id=u.id AND r.role_code='demander' AND r.enabled=1 WHERE u.user_status='active' AND u.id IN #{id} ORDER BY u.id
